Kim — I'm pasting the one-page narrative summary here for quick review. If no objections, I'll package the three artifacts into a Drive zip and produce a secure link for Lena's team.

--- Narrative summary (draft):
Redwood Inference provides two production deployment modes with distinct isolation tradeoffs. Dedicated is a reserved GPU pool with tenant-level compute and logical network segmentation enforced by hypervisor/host fence and per-tenant overlay networks. Private provides a customer-managed VPC with a Private control plane; control-plane traffic is routed over dedicated tunnels into the customer's VPC and customer KMS is supported via external key wrapping. In both modes, runtime safeguards include continuous KV cache namespacing, flow-logging at egress points, and automated tenant-eviction playbooks to contain noisy or malicious workloads. Quantized model variants and fallback routing are implemented at the routing layer to reduce blast radius during overloads.

Action items: final review (Kim), package (Marissa), share secure link with Lena if needed.

Ben
